verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Claude Code can run cloud sessions in the browser with no local setup and work on repos you don't have locally, so the cloud-environment axis applies. However, nothing documents configuring that cloud environment with repository dependencies or setup steps, or making it reproducible. CLAUDE.md (coding standards) and hooks (shell commands around agent actions) are adjacent features, not environment configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs

citations.quote: Run Claude Code in your browser with no local setup.
